```plato
    // EVERY boundary component: the outer ring plus every hole ring.
    Perimeter(r: PolygonWithHoles2D): Number
        => r.Boundary.Perimeter + SumOf(r.Holes.Map(h => h.Perimeter));
```

```plato
    Perimeter(s: PolygonSet2D): Number
        => SumOf(s.Polygons.Map(p => p.Perimeter));
```

## Line 197

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 197](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L197).

```plato

    // 2n equal edges, each the third side of a triangle with sides R and r meeting
    // at pi/n: sqrt(R^2 + r^2 - 2*R*r*cos(pi/n)) by the law of cosines.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Law_of_cosines
    Perimeter(s: RegularStar2D): Number
        => 2.0 * s.PointCount.ToNumber
        * (s.OuterRadius.Square + s.InnerRadius.Square
            - 2.0 * s.OuterRadius * s.InnerRadius
                * (0.5 / s.PointCount.ToNumber).Turns.Cos).Sqrt;
```
